title: Gemfile.lock dependency lockfile served
description: The response is a Bundler lockfile: the GEM section with its remote and the exact resolved versions. It pins every Ruby dependency and its source, which is a precise inventory of what the application runs.
remediation: Exclude lockfiles from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.
limitation: One response body. The rule reads the lockfile shape; it does not query a vulnerability database for the versions.

observation.body:
GEM
  remote: https://rubygems.org/
  specs:
    rails (7.1.3)
    puma (6.4.2)

PLATFORMS
  ruby
Commit the lockfile and install with bundle install.
